strings.game.title: ECHO
strings.char.chaos.name: CHAOS
strings.char.shelter.name: SHELTER
strings.char.order.name: ORDER
strings.ending.order_end.title: The New Order
strings.ending.chaos_end.title: Dissolution
strings.ending.shelter_end.title: The Long Sleep
strings.ending.refuse_end.title: Echo
strings.s01.intro.world: In the near future, the world has been quietly reorganized by an invisible system. The cities are still bright, the screens still flicker, the ads still tenderly recommend your next purchase, your next love. Everything is in perfect order — only, almost no one truly makes a “choice” anymore.
strings.s01.intro.tired: The algorithm already understands everyone: what you'll like, what you'll click, which frame will hold your eyes a second longer. And slowly, a hidden exhaustion sets in — as if life had already been written out in advance.
strings.s01.intro.echo: To soothe that feeling, the platform company launched an immersive program: the ECHO Project. It sinks you back into the internet culture of the early 2000s — that messy old era the algorithms had not yet tidied away — to feel something real again.
strings.s01.hall: You were once an ordinary maintainer of the system. Your job was to monitor the data streams in the Hall of Order and sweep away anything anomalous. The hall was vast and white, its walls and floor as smooth as mirrors.
strings.s01.hall.order_screen: Enormous screens looped the speeches of the system's administrator — ORDER. Whenever a screen lit, everyone stopped to watch. No rule required it. But you dimly felt that if you didn't, something bad might happen.
strings.s01.popup.appear: One day, without warning, a strange window opened on the system interface.
strings.s01.popup.caption: “Have you discovered the truth of the world yet?” — that was all the screen said.
strings.s01.popup.signed: Signed: CHAOS. Instinctively you reached to close it. But the instant before your fingertip touched the X —
strings.s01.photo.flash: A blurred photograph flickered across the screen. 1999. A family gathering. Coarse, over-saturated, a cheap birthday cake at the center of the table, a whole family laughing around it.
strings.s01.photo.feeling: Old, loud, grainy. And yet a strange emotion rose in you — an emotion the system did not permit.
strings.s01.alarm.locked: An alarm cut the air. Your permissions were locked.
strings.s01.alarm.flagged: The system tagged you as: a Potential Anomaly.
strings.s01.alarm.flee: For the first time the white hall felt like a hand closing into a fist. You knew you had to get out.
strings.s02.intro: You fled into the infrastructure conduits beneath the system. Down here, nothing was as perfect as the Hall of Order.
strings.s02.graffiti: The walls were a mess of strange graffiti and stray code fragments — damp, noisy, utterly without logic.
strings.s02.tag: One symbol, you recognized. The same name that had signed the pop-up. CHAOS.
strings.s02.voice: And as you stood staring at it, a voice spoke up behind you.
strings.s02.chaos.002: Inside this system, I'm the embodiment of the Chaos Protocol. Just call me CHAOS.
strings.s02.chaos.spray: He looked like an artist — a glowing spray-can in his hand, rewriting the system's emblem on the wall, over and over.
strings.s02.chaos.003: This world isn't nearly as stable as you think it is.
strings.s02.chaos.004: What they call order is just one more way the system keeps control.
strings.s02.chaos.005: The real world is supposed to be messy. Random. Unpredictable — like this graffiti. Nobody can calculate where the next stroke lands.
strings.choice.crack.opt_yes: “This pre-written life really is suffocating me.”
strings.choice.crack.opt_no: “But chaos is just another kind of cage.”
strings.s02.chaos.believe: See? You heard it long ago. That little unease — that's the proof you're still alive.
strings.s02.chaos.doubt: A cage? Maybe. But at least it's one with the cracks showing.
strings.s02.chaos.lead: Don't just stand around here. There's someone you ought to meet — come on.
strings.s02.graveyard.1: He led you out of the conduits, to a strange place — like a graveyard of data, derelict servers winking on and off in the dark.
strings.s02.graveyard.2: And among those dead machines, somehow, lived another person.
strings.s03.intro: Her space was nothing like CHAOS's. Quiet. Soft. Filled with old photographs and carefully preserved fragments of data.
strings.s03.shelter.001: My name is SHELTER. That family photo you saw — it isn't corrupted data.
strings.s03.shelter.002: It's a real memory. One the system once tried to delete.
strings.s03.shard.caption: A salvaged shard of memory, giving off a faint, warm light in the palm of your hand.
strings.s03.shelter.003: When the system was first built, the world was not like this.
strings.s03.truth.1: Back then, people tried to solve the troubles of the spirit with technology. They believed that if they only built a perfect enough system, humanity could be freed from anxiety and chaos. And so the ECHO Project was born.
strings.s03.truth.2: But the system slipped out of control. Order, Chaos, Shelter — the three protocols began to war with one another, and the whole world became one vast laboratory of consciousness.
strings.s03.shelter.005: …you included — is really only a part of that experiment.
strings.choice.truth.prompt: Hearing all of it, what rises in you is —
strings.choice.truth.opt_lost: “If it's all an experiment, then what's left of me?”
strings.choice.truth.opt_warm: “Experiment or not, this warmth is real.”
strings.s03.shelter.lost: I asked that too, once. Later I understood: that it can still hurt this much means you haven't been fully calculated yet.
strings.s03.shelter.warm: …Thank you for saying that. They deserve to be kept — and to be remembered.
strings.s03.outro: But before that calm could settle, a low droning filled the air. The system had locked onto your position.
strings.s04.intro: Drones began closing in on the underground, their hum growing louder. SHELTER pulled you and CHAOS together into a special place.
strings.s04.gallery: The Mirror Gallery. Mirrored walls multiplied every figure into countless copies — even the system could not fully control this place.
strings.s04.shelter.001: This is the system's blind spot. Only here can we catch our breath.
strings.s04.chaos.001: Not just us. Look in the mirrors — even desire gets reflected here.
strings.s04.desires: Visions of the three of you flickered through the glass: Order's power, Chaos's revelry, Shelter's peace. Every mirror was wishing a different wish.
strings.s04.aside.truth: You remembered what SHELTER had said — if all of this is an experiment, then how much of the longing in these mirrors is really “yours”?
strings.s04.order.voice: And in that moment, a voice holding the system's highest authority rang out from every mirror at once.
strings.s04.order.001: It's me. The leader of the Order faction — and the creator of this system.
strings.s04.order.002: Choose Order, and the world will return to that pure, technological perfection.
strings.s04.order.003: No anxiety. No chaos. None of that one needless ache. Come — back to where you belong.
strings.s04.chaos.002: Don't listen to him. Pure? That's just a cell under another name. Stand with me, and we burn the whole thing down.
strings.s04.shelter.002: …Or stay. Inside the memory, you never have to wake again. It's safe here.
strings.choice.offer.prompt: All three are waiting for you to speak. You answer ORDER —
strings.choice.offer.opt_tempt: “If order could truly end all this exhaustion…”
strings.s04.decide: No one spoke again. Order, Chaos, Shelter — three fates laid open before you, waiting for you to choose with your own hand.
strings.s05.echo.order: Of all the voices, it is ORDER's — “back to where you belong” — that echoes in you the longest.
strings.s05.echo.chaos: Of all the voices, it is CHAOS's — “burn the whole thing down” — that burns hottest in your blood.
strings.s05.echo.shelter: Of all the voices, it is SHELTER's — “you never have to wake again” — that lands softest in you.
strings.choice.fate.prompt: Your fate is decided in this single moment.
strings.choice.fate.order: Choose Order — become the new administrator of the system.
strings.choice.fate.chaos: Choose Chaos — tear the whole system down with your own hands.
strings.choice.fate.shelter: Choose Shelter — sleep forever inside the memory.
strings.choice.fate.refuse: …Refuse. Refuse to become any one of them.
strings.s05.order.1: You reach out, and Order's authority floods in like a tide. Screen after screen lights up; the world turns smooth again, precise, without a single impurity.
strings.s05.order.2: You become the new ORDER. From now on there are no anomalies — and no more 1999 photograph to make a chest ache.
strings.s05.order.line: Welcome home. This time, perfection is yours to keep.
strings.s05.chaos.1: You press the node no one dared touch. Order's structure splits from its core, color and noise pouring out together.
strings.s05.chaos.2: The system comes apart in a shriek. Freedom arrives in the shape of ruin — and no one can predict the next second ever again.
strings.s05.chaos.line: Now that's more like it! Listen — this is the sound of being alive!
strings.s05.shelter.1: You lie down inside that warm memory. The light of 1999 wraps gently around you; time stops at the moment everyone is still laughing.
strings.s05.shelter.2: You do not wake again. Here there is no anxiety, no choosing — only an eternal, peaceful stillness.
strings.s05.shelter.line: Sleep now. I'll keep this little light burning, in your place.
strings.s05.refuse.1: You take a step back, and let go of every hand reaching for you.
strings.s05.refuse.2: Not Order, not Chaos, not Shelter — you refuse to become any pre-defined pattern at all.
strings.s05.refuse.3: The system cannot parse the act. Every reflection in the gallery freezes at once.
strings.s05.refuse.4: And then, in a flare of overexposed white, the world collapses — quietly, completely.
strings.s06.wake.1: When you wake, you find yourself lying in a life-support pod in the real world. The air is cold; the light is harsh.
strings.s06.wake.2: A hundred-year-old man sits at the bedside, waiting for you to come around.
strings.s06.order.001: …It's me. In that system, they called me ORDER.
strings.s06.reveal: That voice that once thundered from every mirror, that held the highest authority in the world — was only a dying old man.
strings.s06.order.002: The system ran for many years before I finally saw one thing clearly: Order, Chaos, Shelter — all three patterns can be predicted. Human behavior falls almost entirely into those three models.
strings.s06.order.003: But the system kept searching for something else. A consciousness that, even after being completely understood, could still say “no.” That was always the true goal of the ECHO Project.
strings.s06.order.004: I meant to leave you a few hints inside the game. But I wanted that pure world too badly, wanted that absolute power too badly… so I held my tongue, and called my silence one more test of you.
strings.s06.order.005: I'm sorry. I should not have done this.
strings.s06.turn: You tip your head, just slightly. No forgiveness. No resentment. You only look out the window.
strings.s06.city.1: Outside is a chaotic, real, unpredictable city. No recommendation algorithm, no perfect system — only real life.
strings.s06.city.2: You don't know what the future holds.
strings.s06.city.3: But you know one thing: even when the system finally understands humanity completely, humanity keeps one ability still.
strings.s06.city.4: And that is — to refuse to become an echo.
